scripts.//: build/start exist for Hostinger, which deploys the dashboard from this repo root and runs `npm run build` then `npm start` there. Everything else on this repo runs under Bun; these two are the only npm entry points. `next start` is NOT used because next.config.ts sets output: standalone, which it explicitly refuses to serve ('next start does not work with output: standalone configuration') — prepare-standalone.sh assembles that output and writes the root server.js shim started below.
scripts.build: cd apps/web && npm run build && bash scripts/prepare-standalone.sh
scripts.dev:workers: cd apps/workers && bun run dev:send & cd apps/workers && bun run dev:import & cd apps/workers && bun run dev:scheduler
